crossRefs.note: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you…
Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…
Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man…
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…
not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

translations.web: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
translations.bsb: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?
translations.kjv: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
translations.asv: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
